push.title: L 3-4 vs Team Takeoff | You: 8.9
push.body:
BellyTb1, that 8.9 was a big ol' slice of good football.

THE GOOD
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). That's playmaking, plain and simple.
+ A goal against Team Takeoff. You found the corner like it owed you rent.
+ You found PhogsToffees and PhogsToffees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 2. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ 1.1 better than usual. The arrow is pointing straight up.

THE BAD
- Shots 1, down from your usual 3. It happens. It can't keep happening.
- Your 5th straight loss. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.
- 2 tackles won cost 0.1. Smarter choices fix it.
- Their humans averaged 9.8 to our 8.3; we were second best man for man. We dug that hole together; we'll climb out together.

THE UGLY
! This was the relegation match we lost: Relegation match L 3-4 vs Team Takeoff. Down to Division 4. You were a passenger. We need drivers.

Skill builder: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

BellyTb1, here's what I'd tell my own kid: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

Hold onto this feeling. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 3-4 vs Team Takeoff | You: 7.7
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.7. I'd rather you have this night now than in a playoff.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at Team Takeoff's goal. You weren't shy, and shy doesn't score.
+ Keep finding BellyTb1; it's working like a charm.
+ 4 goals conceded: +0.2. The little extras matter.
+ 1 key pass pushed +0.1. Underrated work.

THE BAD
- 70% passing (19 of 27, down from your usual 78%). Quick fix: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Easy as pie.
- Their best forward posted 10.0 to your 7.7. I'm not mad, I'm just writing it down.
- Your 5th straight loss. A team result, and it needs a team answer.
- 1 tackle won: -0.1. A little care goes a long way.
- Their humans averaged 9.8 to our 8.3; we were second best man for man. That's where we are. It's not where we're staying.

THE UGLY
! This was the relegation match we lost: Relegation match L 3-4 vs Team Takeoff. Down to Division 4. That's the kind of thing that gets you benched on a real team.

Garden drill: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

PhogsToffees, one more thing before you log off: Biscuits fix most things. Practice fixes the rest.

One rough patch doesn't define a field. - Coach Lasso
